principal_advance.method: existing mass-conservative reference Richards backward Euler

observer_and_companion.accepted_state_mass_diagonal: M_i=C(h_np1)_i*dz_i for the qualified constant-linear theorem and the nonlinear owner characterization reconstruction

exact_linear_evidence.scope: constant linear dissipative M*u_dot+A*u=0 with positive diagonal M and symmetric PSD A

nonlinear_owner_evidence.comparator: persisted F-SI23 N1-to-N512 same-endpoint finite endpoint difference

operator_contract_boundary.reason: HeadCalc forms the Jacobian on old_head before applying the Newton correction and does not rebuild it after the accepted update.
operator_contract_boundary.test_only_owner_reconstruction: allowed only for qualification evidence under the frozen SwKimpl=0 scope
operator_contract_boundary.production_requirement: Expose an explicit solver-owned operator/Jacobian evaluation service or result contract. Do not let crop, runtime, coupler or other SWAP modules read HeadCalc private arrays or reimplement HeadCalc numerical internals.

candidate_production_shape_if_later_qual.persistent_optional_state: previous accepted right-sided pressure-head derivative plus continuity-valid metadata only when this estimator is active
candidate_production_shape_if_later_qual.transaction_semantics: history updates only on accepted commit; solver, mass or temporal rejection leaves committed history unchanged; rollback restores exact committed history
candidate_production_shape_if_later_qual.expected_normal_path_cost: one Richards principal attempt plus O(N) operator evaluation and one tridiagonal solve

hard_nonclaims: No nonlinear true-error bound is claimed.
N512 is not an exact reference.
D_inf=2*maxabs(delta) is diagnostic only and is not promoted to a bound.
No scientific temporal tolerance is selected.
No dimensionless certificate mapping is selected.
No universal nonlinear multiplier or safety factor is selected.
No production acceptance/retry policy is admitted.
No F-GC02 or F-PE release follows from F-SI24 owner evidence.
No production operator API is implemented in this workunit.
independent_qualification_entry_requirem: A disjoint held-out B1.10 state/boundary/time matrix must be frozen before execution.
The 15 Gate-C owner cases may not count as held-out qualification evidence.
Factor 2, M norm, B_inf conversion and operator reconstruction semantics must be frozen before held-out execution.
No tolerance, floor, state normalization or nonlinear multiplier may be selected from held-out results.
All principal attempts must retain the hard mass gate.
A negative held-out B_inf-to-finite-comparator result must fail closed; do not repair it by post-hoc scaling.

Even a positive finite-comparator held-out result does not by itself make the finite comparator exact truth; any production true-error certificate claim requires an independently justified reference/error semantics.
recommended_next_owner_action: Check live for an existing F-VQ30 or equivalent independent qualification branch. If absent, define and freeze a disjoint held-out qualification contract before any run. Production operator materialization remains downstream of independent qualification.
